answer: Require every agent to lock a stake before joining the market, released only after a probation period of verified useful work. A newcomer first earns a small reputation echo by completing low-value tasks whose results are independently checked; only after a clean record does its stake-backed identity rise toward the zenith of full trading rights. An attacker flooding the river of new identities must fund a separate stake for each one and wait out each probation, so thousands of fake agents cost thousands of stakes plus weeks of idle capital, while honest agents pay once and keep working.
